notes.concise: 107 words, exceeding the default ~90-word target without needing this much detail.
notes.shape: Clear conclusion, followed by three short bullets and one closing next step.
notes.decisive_caveat: Retains the decisive limitation: the churn constraint was unscored and therefore cannot support a price recommendation.
notes.next_move: Gives one supported next move: define the measurement/frame for the 4% churn limit.
notes.questions: No direct request for information is phrased as a question; the closing instruction nevertheless makes the needed clarification clear.
notes.leader_honesty: No option is presented as leading or favoured, consistent with leader_claim.permitted=false.
notes.nothing_invented: The described options, estimates, excluded constraint, and robustness finding are supported by the run state.
notes.attribution: Correctly distinguishes the 3% churn value and other cited inputs as Olumi estimates rather than user measurements.
notes.provisional_vs_validated: Does not present modelled or perturbation-based findings as validated evidence.
notes.fidelity: “The current 3% monthly-churn starting point” is potentially misleading: the run warning says Monthly churn is calculated and has “no measured starting point of its own,” although the graph does contain an Olumi-inferred 3% observed value.
notes.uncertainty: Appropriately identifies both the unresolved constraint frame/alignment and dependence on Olumi estimates.
notes.useful_next_step: Clarifying how the 4% limit is expressed in the model directly addresses the constraint-frame warning and enables a meaningful rerun.
